title: AMAZING💕💕
body:
Me+ is a productive app! It has all different types of videos like how to clean ur room without getting overwhelmed or how to medicate during the day. It also gives u some questions at the beginning so the app knows how ur lifestyle is going so it could help u in the future. Ikr smart! It also gives u a contract to sign before u get started! Obviously a fake one but it’s still cool! The contract tells u stuff that u have to do everyday or if u change it to once a week or once a month.It also tells u to be more productive and active. After you’ve read the contract u sign ur signature at the bottom.Theres also premium which u don’t have to get but it makes ur experience better on the app! I personally don’t think u should buy it tho bc the app is still rlly good without it! It makes me soo organised and I luv it! It’s also kinda fun! When I mean kinda fun I mean very fun! Overall I luv me+. If ur parents r looking at the reviews and don’t know if they should get it for their kids, BUY IT! That’s all I’ve got to say abt this amazing app!


-Laraa🌸🌷🎀💐💕

title: I’m not so happy.
body: Maybe this is my fault for doing the toxic personality test, but one of the answers was really triggering for me. It was “ victim mindset “ when I was younger and my mother would shout at me, I learnt to try as hard as I possibly could to not cry. And when I did I would panic and get scared, which only made me cry more because I knew she would get more mad and say “ are you seriously crying? “ “ stop victimising yourself. “ “ would you stop crying? “ “ crying will get you nowhere. “ “ I’m not going to feel bad. “ etc. so that answer was extremely triggering for me.
